author: Jennifer Osburn Thompson
text: I was on Omnipod 5 with the Dexcom G6 and my blood sugars were terrible. I gave it six months and it didn’t work so I went back to Omnipod in manual mode with the Libre and my A1c has come down. The aggravating part is is that Libre is discontinuing the 2 and not making any more 3s. They are only going to have 2+ and 3+ so I can see that causing a problem for you with your insurance unfortunately. ￼
